parameters.query: INSERT INTO production.instagram_media_snapshots (instagram_media_id, media_type, media_product_type, caption, permalink, published_at, reach, views, likes, comments, saves, shares, raw_metrics, raw_media, collected_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::timestamptz, $7, $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13::jsonb, $14::jsonb, $15::timestamptz);

INSERT INTO production.instagram_comment_snapshots (instagram_comment_id, instagram_media_id, comment_text, author_username, commented_at, like_count, raw_comment, collected_at) SELECT c->>'instagram_comment_id', c->>'instagram_media_id', c->>'comment_text', c->>'author_username', NULLIF(c->>'commented_at', '')::timestamptz, NULLIF(c->>'like_count', '')::integer, c->'raw_comment', $2::timestamptz FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) AS c WHERE c->>'instagram_comment_id' IS NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO production.outcomes (channel, source_type, source_id, source_reference, response_window, raw_metrics, raw_responses, repeated_phrase_candidates, response_summary, captured_at, created_at) VALUES ('instagram', 'instagram_media', $1, $2, 'daily_snapshot', $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb, $5::jsonb, $6, $7::timestamptz, now());

WITH params AS (SELECT now() AS run_at, date_trunc('day', now()) AS today_start, date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AS yesterday_start), media_window AS (SELECT * FROM production.instagram_media_snapshots, params WHERE collected_at >= params.yesterday_start), ranked AS (SELECT instagram_media_id, media_type, caption, permalink, published_at, collected_at, coalesce(reach, 0) AS reach, coalesce(views, 0) AS views, coalesce(likes, 0) AS likes, coalesce(comments, 0) AS comments, coalesce(saves, 0) AS saves, coalesce(shares, 0) AS shares, coalesce(reach, 0) + coalesce(views, 0) + (coalesce(likes, 0) * 3) + (coalesce(comments, 0) * 5) + (coalesce(saves, 0) * 6) + (coalesce(shares, 0) * 6) AS score FROM media_window), top_content AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY score DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS items FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 5) r), underperformed AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY score ASC), '[]'::jsonb) AS items FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked ORDER BY score ASC LIMIT 3) r), comment_words AS (SELECT lower(word) AS word, count(*) AS count FROM production.instagram_comment_snapshots c, params, regexp_split_to_table(regexp_replace(coalesce(c.comment_text, ''), '[^[:alnum:]А-Яа-яЁё ]', ' ', 'g'), '\s+') AS word WHERE c.collected_at >= params.yesterday_start AND length(word) >= 4 GROUP BY lower(word) HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10), themes AS (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('theme', word, 'count', count) ORDER BY count DESC), '[]'::jsonb) AS items FROM comment_words), totals AS (SELECT count(*) AS media_count, coalesce(sum(likes), 0) AS likes, coalesce(sum(comments), 0) AS comments, coalesce(sum(saves), 0) AS saves, coalesce(sum(reach), 0) AS reach, coalesce(sum(views), 0) AS views FROM ranked) SELECT params.run_at, totals.media_count, totals.likes, totals.comments, totals.saves, totals.reach, totals.views, top_content.items AS top_content, underperformed.items AS underperformed, themes.items AS repeated_themes FROM params CROSS JOIN totals CROSS JOIN top_content CROSS JOIN underperformed CROSS JOIN themes;
